decision.observation: The farmer is outside on the farmhouse porch at 8:10 a.m.; the mailbox shows no unread letter, and the dirt route east is visible.
decision.hypothesis: Descending the central stairs and following the clear eastern route will begin the trip to Pelican Town and its southern beach exit.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. From the farm, descend the porch stairs and go east via the clear path north of the shrub, through the bus stop into Pelican Town; then turn south instead of continuing to the eastern riverbank. Passing out costs money.
